en.text:
Passively increases Zoom by #Zoom.

Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased <title Absolute Recoil [absRecoil] />
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

title absRecoil (
Absolute Recoil represents how closely grouped your shots will be in the physical environment to an observer. The recoil you experience on-screen remains identical but if you're more zoomed-in, your bullets will end up being grouped closer.
)

//Mod used for low Zoom weapon archetypes
var Zoom = 1
